$comment: Target Intel is one persistent, company-scoped Corporate Asset Discovery Goal. The Main AI reads durable state/frontier, chooses semantic pivots and controlled tools by information gain, revises its plan after results, and requests independent review. Discovery lands observations first; only host-validated owned + reachable candidates can be atomically promoted and handed to EAS.
$comment_allowed_tool_types: No raw scan/CLI category is exposed. Production tools are closed host-owned capabilities: semantic recon_search_intel, artifact-first public-source adapters, generic bounded SubAgents, attribution/reachability/promotion operators, review section tools, and submission/finalization primitives. The model never receives raw provider syntax, credentials, arbitrary destination control, Target mutation, full scanning, login, or exploit tools.
$comment_completion_authority: Completion authority is the operation-frozen intel_goal_v1 review plus deterministic finalizer. It evaluates non-vacuous current-run receipts, evidence/artifact closure, material frontier and residual dispositions, attribution, fresh reachability, dedupe/conflicts, scope-safe promotion, review freshness, and zero active work. The same-chain Company Controller first persists one bounded model-authored StageDeliverable completion-claim envelope; that envelope triggers the host freeze/review flow but never grants PASS authority.
$comment_team_scheduler: One durable Company Controller is the Goal owner. It may request zero or more dynamically named generic workers with exact prompts and subject refs; no provider/fact-category business role is a required lane. Children return evidence-backed observations and never own planning, scope, promotion, review, or final publication.
$comment_handoff: The handoff contains only exact canonical Targets promoted by the host from observations with owned attribution, fresh low-impact reachability, Evidence, provider/query metadata and promotion lineage. Shared, third-party, ambiguous, rejected, unreachable and outcome-unknown observations remain residual evidence and never enter the executable exact set. Promotion does not itself authorize later active scanning.
